sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तदा वाली वचनं वानरेरितम् ।स महर्षिंतदाऽसाद्य याचते स्म कृताञ्जलिः ॥४-११-६२॥।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā tadā vālī vacanaṁ vānareritam ।sa maharṣiṁtadā'sādya yācate sma kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥4-11-62॥।।

translations.english: 'On hearing the monkeys, Vali went to the sage and begged forgiveness with folded hands.
